candidates.title: Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents
candidates.summary: Multimodal agents commonly generate freeform reasoning before each action. candidates.title: Plan or Retrieve First? A Scale Study of Tool Discovery Architectures
candidates.summary: Tool-augmented LLM agents discover relevant APIs from large registries before planning execution, yet finite context windows prohibit injecting all tool definitions into a single prompt. The dominant approach, which we term Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP), embeds the user query and retrieves similar tools via approximate nearest-neighbor search. We study an alternative Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) paradigm in which the LLM first generates Abstract Tool Stubs (hypothesized function signatures describing needed capabilities) which then serve as retrieval queries against the registry. candidates.title: LeRobot 0.6.1 + transformers 5.3 leaves pi0 image embeddings about 45x too small. Which transformers version are you on?
candidates.summary:
A source comparison and a failed parity run found that LeRobot 0.6.1 with transformers 5.3.0 scales pi0 image embeddings about 45x too small. 0.6.1 needs transformers 5.4 or newer. With 5.5.4 and a ported mask patch, our pi0 export matched the old stack (cosine 0.9999997). If you run pi0 or pi0.5 inference, which transformers version is in your environment, and do your action outputs look right? I can share the comparison script.
